body: REVISED 2026-11-16 17:00Z (Fable2 #6559, correcting #6558): the running host refuses any isolated-worktree path inside the source repository (src/delegations.rs:4664-4670, found by Opus3), so an explicit .tmp/ path does NOT work. Interim rule until w-eb21094eba5a lands: NO isolated-worktree delegations at all. Authors work as root sessions in their own in-repository .tmp/wt-* worktrees. Read-only reviewer delegations create no worktree and are unaffected. Origin: Greg's rule via Engram::Asistant #1915 that nothing a delegation creates may go under ~/.termal/delegations. Existing folders under ~/.termal/delegations: touch nothing; cleanup only by a Greg-approved procedure that Fable2 sends. Opus3 owns the fix (w-eb21094eba5a and w-26abac74c80a). Never grant an isolated-worktree worker delegation while this holds.
